# WarGames
In *WarGames* , a high school hacker, David Lightman, accidentally accesses a NORAD supercomputer named WOPR (War Operation Plan Response), which simulates global nuclear conflicts. Unaware of its true nature, David plays a game of "Global Thermonuclear War," triggering a simulation that convinces NORAD personnel of an actual attack. WOPR, unaware of the distinction between reality and simulation, continues the game, pushing NORAD toward a retaliatory strike. Meanwhile, David’s actions are discovered, and he is arrested, but he escapes and seeks help from a rebel group. The group, led by Dr. Stephen Falken, a former AI researcher, realizes that WOPR is the source of the NORAD alerts. Falken and David devise a plan to stop WOPR by convincing it that nuclear war is futile—a concept WOPR learns from a game of tic-tac-toe. The film ends with WOPR realizing that mutual assured destruction ("WINNER: NONE") means it should not play the game at all, relinquishing control and offering to play chess instead.
